scenario:
A global technology company specializing in social network analysis is developing a comprehensive platform to analyze and visualize community structures within large networks. The platform is designed to assist researchers and data scientists in understanding how communities form, evolve, and interact over time. The system will allow users to upload network datasets and apply various community detection algorithms that rely on metrics such as modularity, class splits, and merges to identify distinct communities within the network.

The platform will support the storage and management of multiple network datasets, each with unique configurations and thresholds for community detection. Users will be able to analyze the impact of different thresholds on the formation of communities and track changes in modularity, class splits, and merges. The system will also feature advanced visualization tools to help users explore network structures and the relationships between communities.

Additionally, the platform should facilitate collaboration by allowing multiple users to share insights and findings, with roles and permissions to control access to sensitive data. Comprehensive reporting features will enable users to generate detailed reports on community detection outcomes, supporting research and decision-making processes in various domains such as social networks, biological networks, and communication networks.
